headline: Approved sign applications for QXO at 197 Commercial Street and Good Neighbor Accounting Firm at 671 Salem Street.
summary: The committee reviewed compliance updates on abandoned signs at 269-271 Main St, Forest & Sylvan St, and 17 Charles Auto Bazaar. It then approved two sign applications: one from QXO at 197 Commercial Street and one from Good Neighbor Accounting Firm at 671 Salem Street.
decisions: Approved the sign application from QXO at 197 Commercial Street, 3 Yea 0 Nay.
Approved the sign application from Good Neighbor Accounting Firm at 671 Salem Street, 3 Yea 0 Nay.

CITY OF MALDEN
MASSACHUSETTS

Meeting Minutes

Approval of Minutes
 From: February 12, 2026
Approved By: Ari Taylor
Seconded By: Nelson Miller
Updates from Compliance:
269-271 Main St- The Breakfast Club - Abandoned sign/banner. Tickets issued. 
Sign/Banner is supposed to be removed this week.
Forest & Sylvan St-  SNOWBLOWER TUNE-UP sign removed from telephone 
pole.
17 Charles AUTO BAZZAR - Letter mailed to property owner about abandoned 
signs on the property. Used car sales appeared to have gone out of business. Lot
is empty and one sign has been removed from the lot. There is still a sign on the 
building.
MAXIMA AUTO SALES- Sign on the empty lot. Maxima moved from this location 
several years ago. This sign was covered by the AUTO BAZAAR sign which was 
recently taken down.
The following designs were considered for approval:
1. The Committee reviewed a sign application from QXO located at 197 
Commercial Street. Jason Parillo from Pro Sign Service was present. The
Committee voted to approve the sign. Motion was made by Ari Taylor ,
Seconded by Nelson Miller
3 Yea 0 Nay
2. The Committee reviewed a sign application from Good Neighbor 
Accounting Firm located at 671 Salem Street. Beverly Adonis business 
owner was present. The Committee voted to approve the sign. Motion 
made by Ari Taylor. Seconded by Nelson Miller
3 Yea 0 Nay
Meeting adjourned at :
Time: 9:21 AM
By: Jadeane Sica
Motion By: Ari Taylor
Seconded By: Nelson Miller
Minutes respectfully submitted by : Gia Finocchiaro
